decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY updates the dedicated no-referral copy but leaves broader About-page mechanics copy requiring an $18 commission and $900 entry for missing referrals, which conflicts with the new $10 weighted-draw rule and optional ticket outcome.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Whether or not a 'code-free purchase' generates 6 tickets could go either way, so a missing ticket on that kind of purchase may be acceptable.

The unresolved question is where the $10 commission goes on those no-referral mints. I would like those commissions to default to me, but that could encourage sympathetic buyers to omit their referral codes and discourage affiliates from participating. Because of that, the $10 commission from no-referral purchases has to be assigned by weighted draw.

value_updates.prize_mechanics_content: Explain that an accepted valid referral gives the chosen referrer a $25 credit and entry into the $2,000 reward drawing. For a missing referral, explain that the $10 commission is assigned by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners and that six tickets are not guaranteed. Preserve the existing rejected-referral rule of an $18 commission and a $900 draw entry assigned to a random NFT owner.
value_updates.prize_mechanics_copy: Describe the conditional referral outcomes: accepted referrals enter the chosen referrer into the $2,000 reward drawing; a missing referral assigns the $10 commission by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners without guaranteeing six tickets; a rejected referral retains its $18 commission and $900 draw entry assigned to a random NFT owner.
value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: Explain that a code-free purchase does not necessarily create six tickets, while its $10 commission must be assigned by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners.

decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already changes the no-referral commission to $10 and requires weighted-draw allocation among eligible NFT owners.
The source does not establish a replacement ticket rule; the existing same-message AMBIGUOUS Event correctly records that six tickets are no longer mandatory but the outcome remains unresolved.

The landing-page referral copy still requires an $18 commission and $900 entry when a referral is missing, so it must be revised to reflect the $10 weighted-draw commission and non-mandatory ticket outcome for missing referrals.
